name: hcb-dev
description: Personal developer baseline. Injects per-scope language house style (chat / plan-spec notes / code comments / project docs / GitHub-GitLab issues) each session via a SessionStart hook, configurable in plugin settings. Synchronizes canonical cross-project rules (branching & PR flow, issue tracking, early-stage policy) into a project's .claude/rules/hcb/ via the /hcb-dev:rules command, with a PreToolUse guard and a SessionStart drift check keeping the managed copies faithful to canon. Also ships skills for resolving dependency versions (keeping GitHub Dependabot config in sync) and pulling current library docs from Context7.
